narrative.rotation_signal: Clear rotation INTO mega-cap AI/cloud (GOOG, ORCL, NVDA, MSFT, GOOGL, AAPL, AMD) and defensive consumer staples (WMT, PG, JNJ, HD), OUT OF semicap equipment (KLAC, LRCX, AMAT, TXN) and select payments/energy/defense (MA, CVX, RTX). Smart money is barbelling AI compute + staples while distributing the semi capex cycle.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: Semicap equipment bearishness (KLAC/LRCX/AMAT/TXN) may diverge from broader semiconductor industry sentiment which typically tracks NVDA/AMD strength. TSLA bearish read despite max DP/blocks conviction is notable — structural put bias contradicts headline mega-cap bullishness.
